verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only fragments of data portability. The official CLI can import and export Firebase Auth users, and Firestore Enterprise offers a MongoDB-compatible API that lets existing MongoDB tools touch the data. One community user also treats Realtime Database as a JSON store they could export. Other users report real lock-in, and say security rules must be reimplemented after leaving. Missing for 10: a documented full-project export across Firestore, Realtime Database and Storage; stated open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV) for all products; a documented migration path off the platform; independent hands-on confirmation of a complete exit.
